title: The Book of 1 John Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 1 John — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.decoded: What has existed from the very beginning, what we heard, what we saw with our own eyes, what we looked at closely, and what our hands touched—the Word of life;

verses.kjv: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.decoded: The life was shown to us, and we saw it, and we testify about it, and we tell you about the eternal life that was with the Father and was shown to us;

verses.kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: What we have seen and heard, we tell you so that you can share fellowship with us. Our fellowship is truly with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.decoded: We write these things to you so that your joy may be complete.

verses.kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.decoded: This is the message we heard from him and now tell you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.

verses.kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.decoded: If we say that we share fellowship with him but live in darkness, we are lying and not living by the truth.

verses.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.decoded: But if we live in the light, just as he is in the light, we share fellowship with each other, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

verses.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.decoded: If we say that we have no sin, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

verses.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.decoded: If we admit our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.decoded: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar, and his word is not in us.

verses.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.decoded: My dear children, I am writing this to you so you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have someone to speak to the Father for us—Jesus Christ, who is righteous.

verses.kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for our's only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.decoded: He is the sacrifice that takes away our sins, and not only ours but the sins of the whole world.

verses.kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.decoded: We know that we truly know him if we obey his commands.

verses.kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who says, 'I know him,' but does not obey his commands is a liar, and the truth is not in them.

verses.kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.decoded: But whoever obeys his word truly shows that God’s love is made complete in them. This is how we know we are in him.

verses.kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.decoded: Anyone who says they live in him should live as Jesus did.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one you have had from the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard from the beginning.

verses.kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.decoded: But now I am writing you a new command. It is true in Jesus and in you because the darkness is gone, and the true light is already shining.

verses.kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.decoded: Anyone who says they are in the light but hates their brother is still in darkness.

verses.kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who loves their brother lives in the light, and there is nothing in them to cause them to stumble.

verses.kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.decoded: But anyone who hates their brother is in darkness and walks in darkness. They do not know where they are going because the darkness has blinded their eyes.

verses.kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
verses.decoded: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven because of Jesus’ name.

verses.kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
verses.decoded: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know him who has existed from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have defeated the evil one. I write to you, dear children, because you know the Father.

verses.kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
verses.decoded: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who has existed from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and God’s word lives in you, and you have defeated the evil one.

verses.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.decoded: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in them.

verses.kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.decoded: For everything in the world—the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and pride in possessions—does not come from the Father but from the world.

verses.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.decoded: The world and its desires will pass away, but whoever does what God wants will live forever.

verses.kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.decoded: Dear children, this is the last hour. You have heard that the antichrist is coming, and now many antichrists have come. This shows that it is the last hour.

verses.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.decoded: They left us, but they were not really part of us. If they had been, they would have stayed with us. But they left so that everyone would see that they were not really part of us.

verses.kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.decoded: But you have received the Holy Spirit from God, and you all know the truth.

verses.kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.decoded: I do not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it, and because no lie comes from the truth.

verses.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.decoded: Who is a liar? Anyone who denies that Jesus is the Messiah. Such a person is the antichrist—denying both the Father and the Son.

verses.kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.decoded: Anyone who denies the Son does not have the Father either. But whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

verses.kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.decoded: So let what you heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will continue to live in the Son and in the Father.

verses.kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
verses.decoded: And this is the promise God has given us—eternal life.

verses.kjv: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.decoded: I have written these things to warn you about those who try to lead you away.

verses.kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
verses.decoded: But the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. Instead, his anointing teaches you about all things and is true and not a lie. So just as it has taught you, remain in him.

verses.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.decoded: And now, dear children, continue to live in him. Then when he appears, we will be confident and will not be ashamed before him at his coming.

verses.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
verses.decoded: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.

verses.kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.decoded: Look at the great love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God. That is why the world does not recognize us, because it did not recognize him.

verses.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, now we are children of God, but what we will be has not yet been made clear. We know that when he appears, we will be like him, because we will see him as he really is.

verses.kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.decoded: Everyone who has this hope in him makes himself pure, just as he is pure.

verses.kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.decoded: Anyone who sins breaks the law, because sin is breaking the law.

verses.kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.decoded: You know that he appeared to take away our sins, and in him there is no sin.

verses.kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who lives in him does not keep on sinning. Anyone who keeps on sinning has not seen him or known him.

verses.kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.decoded: Dear children, do not let anyone deceive you. The person who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

verses.kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.decoded: The person who sins belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God appeared to destroy the devil’s work.

verses.kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
verses.decoded: Anyone born of God does not continue to sin, because God’s seed remains in them; they cannot keep on sinning because they have been born of God.

verses.kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.decoded: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: anyone who does not do what is right is not God’s child, nor is anyone who does not love their brother.

verses.kjv: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.decoded: This is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

verses.kjv: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
verses.decoded: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his own actions were evil, but his brother’s were righteous.

verses.kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.decoded: Do not be surprised, my brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

verses.kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
verses.decoded: We know that we have passed from death to life because we love each other. Anyone who does not love remains in death.

verses.kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life living in them.

verses.kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.decoded: This is how we know what love is: Jesus laid down his life for us. And we should lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
verses.decoded: If anyone has enough money to live well and sees a brother or sister in need but refuses to help, how can God’s love be in that person?

verses.kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.decoded: Dear children, let us stop just saying we love others; let us really love them, and show it by our actions.

verses.kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
verses.decoded: This is how we know that we belong to the truth and can confidently stand before God.

verses.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.decoded: If our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts and knows everything.

verses.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.decoded: And we receive from him anything we ask, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.

verses.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.decoded: His command is this: to believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and to love one another as he commanded us.

verses.kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
verses.decoded: Those who obey his commands live in him, and he lives in them. We know he lives in us by the Spirit he gave us.

verses.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test them to see if they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.decoded: You can recognize the Spirit of God this way: every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ came as a human is from God.

verses.kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
verses.decoded: But every spirit that does not acknowledge that Jesus Christ came as a human is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming, and it is already in the world.

verses.kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.decoded: You belong to God, little children, and you have defeated them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

verses.kjv: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.decoded: Those who belong to the world speak from the world, and the world listens to them.

verses.kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.decoded: We belong to God. Anyone who knows God listens to us; anyone who does not belong to God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

verses.kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.

verses.kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.decoded: Anyone who does not love does not know God, because God is love.

verses.kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
verses.decoded: God showed his love for us in this way: he sent his one and only Son into the world so that we might live through him.

verses.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.decoded: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the sacrifice that takes away our sins.

verses.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we also should love one another.

verses.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
verses.decoded: No one has ever seen God. But if we love one another, God lives in us, and his love is made complete in us.

verses.kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.decoded: We know that we live in him and he lives in us because he has given us his Spirit.

verses.kjv: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
verses.decoded: We have seen and testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
verses.decoded: Anyone who declares that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them, and they live in God.

verses.kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
verses.decoded: We have come to know and believe the love God has for us. God is love, and anyone who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in them.

verses.kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
verses.decoded: Our love is made complete in this: that we have confidence on the day of judgment, because as Jesus is, so are we in this world.

verses.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.decoded: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

verses.kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.decoded: We love because God first loved us.

verses.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verses.decoded: If anyone says, 'I love God,' but hates their brother or sister, they are a liar. For anyone who does not love their brother or sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen.

verses.kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.decoded: This is the command God has given us: anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.

verses.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who believes that Jesus is the Messiah is born of God; and anyone who loves the Father also loves the children He has given birth to.

verses.kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
verses.decoded: We know we love God's children when we love God and obey His commands.

verses.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.decoded: This is what it means to love God: to obey His commands. And His commands are not difficult to follow.

verses.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verses.decoded: Anyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that defeats the world—our faith.

verses.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.decoded: Who can defeat the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.decoded: Jesus Christ came by water and blood—not just by water, but by water and blood. And the Spirit confirms this, because the Spirit is truth.

verses.kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
verses.decoded: There are three who testify in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit. These three are one.

verses.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
verses.decoded: There are also three who testify on earth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood. These three agree as one.

verses.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
verses.decoded: If we accept human testimony, God's testimony is greater, because this is the testimony God has given about His Son.

verses.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
verses.decoded: Anyone who believes in the Son of God has this testimony in their heart. Anyone who does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because they do not believe the testimony God has given about His Son.

verses.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.decoded: This is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

verses.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has the Son has life; anyone who does not have the Son of God does not have life.

verses.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.decoded: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know you have eternal life, and so you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

verses.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.decoded: We have confidence in approaching God, because if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

verses.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
verses.decoded: And if we know that He hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked from Him.

verses.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
verses.decoded: If anyone sees a brother or sister sinning in a way that does not lead to death, they should ask, and God will give life to those who sin in ways that do not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying to pray about that.

verses.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.decoded: All wrongdoing is sin, but not all sin leads to death.

verses.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
verses.decoded: We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the one born of God protects themselves, and the evil one cannot harm them.

verses.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
verses.decoded: We know that we belong to God, and the whole world is under the control of the evil one.

verses.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.decoded: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding so that we know the true God. We are in the true God, and in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

verses.kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
verses.decoded: Dear children, keep yourselves away from idols. Amen.
